bio: One of the most idyllic places for a spot of Afternoon Tea, MacDonald Elmers Court offers classic Afternoon Tea in a sprawling 19th century Tudor Manor for a more refined occasion.  Perched atop the Solent Coast on the outskirts of the New Forest, there are 23 acres of grounds to explore before dining. Step inside and you will find simple but elegant country-living decor with mahogany furnishings and tasteful decoration.  They provide a traditional three-tier stand with finger sandwiches, delicious preserves and homemade scones, pastries and cakes. Looking for a light bite? Macdonald Elmers Court speciailise in tea and have a range of infusions served with homemade shortbread  Just a short stroll away is Lymington Pier Rail Station, or stay longer and visit the beautiful landscapes of Isle of Wight and Hampshire.
